title: Workplace interventions for burnout: a systematic review and meta-analysis

fields.name: objective
fields.value: to synthesize evidence on organizational interventions for reducing burnout among adult employees
fields.evidence_span: This systematic review aimed to synthesize evidence on organizational interventions for reducing burnout among adult employees.

fields.name: boolean_query
fields.evidence_span: (burnout OR "emotional exhaustion") AND (intervention OR program OR trial) AND (workplace OR organizational)

fields.name: databases_used
fields.evidence_span: We searched PubMed, PsycINFO and Scopus

fields.name: inclusion_criteria
value: randomized controlled trials and quasi-experimental studies
fields.evidence_span: We included randomized controlled trials and quasi-experimental studies of adult employees.

fields.name: n_studies_final
fields.evidence_span: 58 studies met the inclusion criteria and were included in the synthesis

title: Machine learning for code smell detection: a systematic review

fields.name: objective
fields.value: to characterize machine learning approaches for automated code smell detection and to identify open research challenges
fields.evidence_span: The goal of this systematic review is to characterize machine learning approaches for automated code smell detection and to identify open research challenges.

fields.name: boolean_query
fields.value: ("code smell" OR "bad smell" OR anti-pattern) AND ("machine learning" OR classification OR "deep learning")
fields.evidence_span: ("code smell" OR "bad smell" OR anti-pattern) AND ("machine learning" OR classification OR "deep learning")

fields.name: databases_used
fields.evidence_span: executed it on IEEE Xplore, the ACM Digital Library and Scopus

fields.name: snowballing
